# Modules of this package that are extracted Rust rather than prose.
#
#   module   crate              sources        charon scope
#
# `sources` is what the extraction is a function of: the extraction is in sync when the hash of
# those files matches the one recorded in `sync.lock`. Keep it as narrow as the scope really is --
# a wider glob costs false alarms on every unrelated edit, a narrower one lets the generated file
# go stale without the check noticing.
#
# `scope` is the `--start-from` pattern, so the module holds only what its chapter is about.
# `*` matches one path segment, not a subtree: `m::*` takes the module's own items and leaves every
# `impl Type` block out, because a method is named `m::Type::method` -- two segments deeper. Give a
# comma-separated list to include them, e.g. `m::*,m::Type::*`; each pattern is passed separately.
#
# The scope below is deliberately the narrow one. The full scope
#   ferrosa_sstable::compression::*,ferrosa_sstable::compression::Compression::*
# does bring `Compression::decompress` -- the function the ledger's decompression row is about; the
# emitted module mentions it 99 times -- but aeneas then hits 7 internal errors
# (`alloc::io::error::Error::other`, `alloc::boxed::From`, the zstd RefCell wrapper) and the module
# does not elaborate: 16 Lean errors, all of the shape `core.result.Result Usize
# ferrosa_common.error.Error` in a position that expects a product type, plus `synthInstanceFailed`
# on `core.convert.From (Dyn …) Str`. Fix the translator first, then widen this row.
#
# Regenerate one with `./extract.sh <module>`; check them all with `./check-sync.sh`.

Storage   ferrosa-storage   src/count.rs       ferrosa_storage::count::*
Sstable   ferrosa-sstable   src/compression.rs ferrosa_sstable::compression::*

# `ferrosa-view` is not here yet, and the reason is worth writing down because the obvious guess is
# wrong: the memory ceiling is no longer what stops it. With its five derived `Deserialize` impls
# made opaque through `scope.toml`, the crate translates in 28 s at 2.3 GiB peak (it could not
# finish one function before), but the module does not elaborate -- aeneas cannot translate the
# signature of `ViewMetadata::primary_key` or `validate::base_pk_names` (`impl Iterator<Item = &str>`
# triggers `[Error] Unimplemented: found an occurrence of a lifetime constraint`). Add a row when the
# translator can express the type; see SYNC.md, "What the scope buys, measured".
